fusions.name: Spore Slap
fusions.desc: A spore-slimed slap that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Seeded Dead
fusions.desc: Croaks spores onto up to 3 bodies within 9 tiles for 30 seconds. Each one bursts the moment an enemy comes within 2 tiles of it and deals 26 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Mossy Pad
fusions.desc: Raises a damp mat of moss and spores where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Rot Feeds the Pad
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
